steps.en: Install runsc on the node and register it as a container runtime
steps.zh: 在节点上装 runsc 并注册成容器运行时

steps.en: Restart the container manager so it picks up the new runtime
steps.zh: 重启容器管理器，让它识别新运行时

steps.en: Run the workload with the runsc runtime selected
steps.zh: 选用 runsc 运行时来跑工作负载

steps.en: Starts a sandbox and intercepts the workload's system calls
steps.zh: 启动 sandbox，拦截工作负载的系统调用

steps.en: Answers them from the Sentry userspace kernel instead of the host kernel
steps.zh: 由用户态 Sentry 内核应答，而不是宿主内核

steps.en: Keeps most of the host kernel behind a filtered surface
steps.zh: 把宿主内核暴露面挡在自己的过滤之后

value.en: Untrusted containers on a shared host lose their direct path to the host kernel — without running a VM
value.zh: 共享宿主机上的不可信容器失去直通宿主内核的路径——而且不用跑虚拟机

sources: https://github.com/google/gvisor#what-is-gvisor (application kernel, runsc OCI runtime, not a syscall filter nor a VM)
